course_name_original: State space control for robotic systems
course_name_en: State space control for robotic systems
prerequisites: Classical control systems: differential models, transfer functions and their properties.

learning_outcomes.text: Model simple mechatronic and robotic systems in the state-space
Analyze structural properties and internal properties of systems from state-space models and from detailed block diagrams
Design controllers in the state space and with state-feedback and output feedback architectures
Design observers in the state space
Understand the utility of modern control and of working in the estate space
Know how to model in the state space from differential model and from transfer function and vice-versa
Know how to analyse the (structural and internal) properties of a system from its state-space model
Know how to design a state-feedback and output-feedback controller
Know how to design a Luenberger observer

assessment_rules: The evaluation formula is (1*DS1 + 1*TP1) / 2. This implies an equal weighting of the exam (DS1) and the lab project (TP1).
bibliography: Modern control systems, Richard Dorf and Robert Bishop, Pearson Education Limited, 2010, ISBN-10 ‏: 0136024580.
Commande et estimation multivariables: Méthodes linéaires et optimisation quadratique, Eric Ostertag, 2006, Ellipses, ISBN-10 ‏: 2729828036.
degree: Titre d'ingénieur ENIT (cycle ingénieur, semestres 5-10; orientación mecánica/producción)
